questions.question: In the story of Daniel and the lions' den, a decree said no one could pray to any god or man for thirty days except whom?
When King Darius hurried to the lions' den at dawn and called out to Daniel, what did he ask?

answers.text: If Daniel's God was able to deliver him
If Daniel was ready to bow to the king
If Daniel could forgive him for the decree
